target_customer: Trucking carriers and freight brokers buying and bidding on spot loads
problem: Spot freight opportunities are scattered across shipper portals and email, causing empty miles and slow bidding.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating loads from many portals and email requires many integrations and parsing; standard engineering with messy inputs.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and bid rules create some workflow lock-in; no proprietary data evidence.

market_need_then: Launch post claims $5,100 monthly revenue two months after launch (company-reported).

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: A Better Way to Win Freight

pivots.to: Pricing strategy and automation platform for brokers and carriers (AI assistants Manny and Console)
pivots.why: Not stated; undated, based on current site

outcome_analysis: Manifold Freight is a W24 company founded by two Convoy engineers, listed Active. Its site moved from manifoldfreight.com to getmanifold.ai and now positions it as a freight pricing and automation platform with AI agents, suggesting broadened scope. No verified funding or outcome facts are available yet.
notes: Web search budget ran out. YC page cites a GeekWire headline dated 2024-05-20: 'raises $1.9M'; GeekWire returned 403 so amount and investors are unverified and not recorded as a round. Domain moved manifoldfreight.com to getmanifold.ai (301); date unknown. No competitor search done.
